primitives.name: Settled Pick Export
primitives.verbatim_quote: # Settled picks export (calibration / ranker labels) **No foundation training code in-repo.** Export only when you need offline calibration.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'p.id': 'scalar identifier', 'p.sportKey': 'categorical sport label', 'p.pickType': 'categorical pick type', 'p.line': 'dimensionless spread value', 'p.confidence': 'probability scalar [0,1]', 'p.modelVersion': 'scalar version identifier', 'p.result': 'binary outcome {0,1}', 'p.settledAt': 'timestamp UTC', 'g.startTime': 'timestamp UTC'}
primitives.assumptions: Outcome is deterministic post-settlement; features are static at pick time.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Null result or unset timestamp implies incomplete data.

layer2.mapping: Each pick corresponds to a labeled instance in a supervised learning framework where p.result is target variable and other fields are covariates.
layer2.telemetry: Accuracy of calibrated confidence scores vs actual outcomes.

primitives.name: Intent Rows
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Intent Rows of settled picks with features + outcome for lightweight ranker/calibration experiments.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'p.id': 'scalar identifier', 'p.sportKey': 'categorical sport label', 'p.pickType': 'categorical pick type', 'p.line': 'dimensionless spread value', 'p.confidence': 'probability scalar [0,1]', 'p.modelVersion': 'scalar version identifier', 'p.result': 'binary outcome {0,1}', 'p.settledAt': 'timestamp UTC', 'g.startTime': 'timestamp UTC'}
primitives.assumptions: Features are representative of pre-game conditions; intent remains stable across settlement.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Missing feature values or inconsistent labeling invalidate row integrity.

layer2.mapping: Intent rows form kernel space for lightweight rankers; each row defines a point in feature-outcome Euclidean space.
layer2.telemetry: Rank correlation between predicted and true confidence rankings.

primitives.name: SQL Sketch
primitives.verbatim_quote: SELECT p.id, p."sportKey", p."pickType", p.line, p.confidence, p."modelVersion", p.result, p."settledAt", g."startTime" FROM picks p JOIN games g ON g.id = p."gameId" WHERE p.result IS NOT NULL AND p."settledAt" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p."settledAt" DESC LIMIT 5000; ``` Export CSV → offline notebook.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\mathcal{D}': 'dataset of N samples', 'x_i': 'feature vector of length k', 'y_i': 'binary outcome label', 'N': 'sample count limit'}
primitives.assumptions: Data is temporally ordered and complete for selected subset.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Limitation arises from fixed sample size and temporal filtering.

layer2.mapping: Relational query maps to structured dataset; SQL schema aligns with statistical design matrix formulation.
layer2.telemetry: Query execution time and row count consistency.
